propositions: After a successful new-writer save, the inline last_get_pass field is absent from every entry in bindings.json, and all rotation state is persisted to get_rotation.json
When sidecar persistence (get_rotation.json write) fails open, the primary binding save succeeds with the latest inline last_get_pass value retained as a failure-recovery floor
A crash or failure after the sidecar replace but before the bindings replace does not lose the maximum rotation value, because the max is already durably stored in the sidecar

The save operation establishes a strict ordering: merge staged inline values into sidecar using chronological max, atomically persist sidecar, then remove inline fields and atomically write bindings.json
An old-writer followed by new-writer sequence that reintroduces a later inline stamp safely migrates that maximum into get_rotation.json before scrubbing the inline field
All writer classes (GHA reconciler and local probe) are upgraded to A2-1-or-newer binaries, verified by CI evidence and host probe refresh, enabling safe removal of the legacy inline field
